All four arguments are analytic and the finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: Changing the residence-time distribution from memoryless to Erlang-2 while preserving the mean is a physically natural, nontrivial control of run–tumble non-Gaussianity. The general three-statistic reduction is useful for independent nonexponential inactivity laws; exact non-Gaussianity sign and strict threshold ordering characterize the first nontrivial phase-type case across all run rates. This is a structural distinction rather than a textbook parameter substitution.
